question: Is the spiritual son so great — and who is blind on the path?
premises: the spiritual son would not be so great — but fitting to own strength
is blind, as on a path
inference: Sonship confers no greatness beyond own strength; the deprived are blind.
plain_english: The spiritual son would not be so great — but fitting to own strength; but who is deprived of knowledge-yoga is blind, as on a path.
